CustomField.description: The agreement number is used to help users identify the asset as per the CMS ID (Vienna and TSA). The format of the agreement number is as follows Stand alone finance, Contract hire, Lease with R&M= VFS Connect Contract Number & asset ID in format or _0001 (concatenated). For stand alone maintenance= Initiations Asset ID (beginning with a 5 and with 7 unique sequential numeric characters). This number is also used to link the contract to the initiation asset
CustomField.label: Agreement number
